2610.04088.title: Towards Safer Autonomous Driving in an Open World: A Dual-Process Approach
2610.04088.paper_summary: Before autonomous driving systems can be deployed on public roads, it is vital that these systems comply with safety standards, traffic rules, and social norms. Although neural networks trained on large amounts of driving data perform well in routine driving tasks, these models often struggle in novel situations that are not well-represented in the data. In this work, we propose a novel framework that combines a neural network for intuitive, learning-based planning in routine driving tasks with model predictive control for reasoning-based planning in unfamiliar situations, inspired by Dual Process Theory. A meta-cognitive component is designed to switch between the two, using a knowledge graph to reason about contextual risk based on explicit perceptual information and relevant traffic rules and social norms. Contextual risk is represented through risk fields, guiding both the switching mechanism in the meta-cognitive component and compliance with safety standards, traffic rules, and social norms in the reasoning-based planner. The effectiveness of our framework is tested in CARLA for variations of a typical out-of-distribution situations involving (emergency) vehicles running a red light. We show that the novel architecture reduces the number of collisions in the scenarios by 89% and improves compliance with the special right-of-way rules, compared to the NN-only planner.
2610.04088.paper_summary_zh: 在自駕系統能夠在公共道路上部署之前，這些系統必須遵循安全標準、交通規則和社會規範。儘管在大量駕駛數據上訓練的神經網絡在日常駕駛任務中表現良好，但這些模型在數據中未能充分代表的新情況下往往會遇到困難。在本研究中，我們提出了一個新穎的框架，結合了用於日常駕駛任務的直觀學習型規劃的神經網絡與用於不熟悉情況下推理型規劃的模型預測控制，靈感來自雙重過程理論。設計了一個元認知組件，以在這兩者之間切換，利用知識圖譜根據明確的感知信息和相關的交通規則及社會規範來推理上下文風險。上下文風險通過風險場表示，引導元認知組件中的切換機制以及推理型規劃器對安全標準、交通規則和社會規範的遵循。我們在CARLA中測試了我們框架的有效性，針對涉及（緊急）車輛闖紅燈的典型分佈外情況的變化。我們顯示，與僅使用NN的規劃器相比，這種新穎的架構將場景中的碰撞數量減少了89%，並改善了對特殊讓行規則的遵守。
